dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/4] The results of the repeated measures MANOVA for CDI, LSSP and MESSY total score revealed no significant group or group by occasions effects. There was, however, a significant occasions effect (Pillais F — 5- 91, d.f. = 3- 26, P < 0-001), indicating a tendency for subjects in general to change over time on the dependent measures considered in this analysis. The univariate analyses of variance demonstrated that the only measure to show a significant change in pre- to post-treatment scores was the CDI(F = 14-02, d.f. = 1-28, P < 0-001). Inspection of Table 1 reveals that subjects in all groups tended to improve over time on the CDI.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/15] Treatment effects were analysed by means of two repeated measures of MANOVAs. These were conducted separately for two sets of variables: (a) CDI, LSSP and MESSY total score, and (b) MESSY factor scores.
